deadline.value: Admission is for summer 2027 only; materials must arrive by January 15, 2027 to be considered for funding.
deadline.quote: To be considered for funding, required admissions materials must be received by January 15.

gre_general.value: GRE General verbal and quantitative scores are required.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Application requires form, transcripts, letters, and GRE scores submitted to the Graduate School; no prior supervisor is required.
supervisor.quote: Applicants must submit the following: | A Baylor University application form | Official transcripts that bear the seal from all colleges or universities attended | Three letters of reference | GRE scores (verbal & quantitative)

funding.value: Ph.D. applicants are considered for an assistantship and tuition waiver, awarded competitively.
funding.quote: Ph.D. applicants will be considered for a graduate assistantship and a tuition waiver. These awards are made on a competitive basis.

entry_route.value: The Graduate School requires a bachelor's or equivalent degree, and the statistics page lists no master's requirement.
entry_route.quote: Graduate School applicants must hold a bachelor's or equivalent professional degree.

english_waiver.value: The statistics page waives TOEFL only for a U.S.-accredited degree, so an Indian degree does not qualify here.
english_waiver.quote: International students are required to submit TOEFL scores unless they have received a degree from a U.S.-accredited higher education institution.

notes: The Data Science concentration is a track of this PhD (https://statistics.artsandsciences.baylor.edu/graduate/doctor-philosophy-phd/data-science-concentration), so datasci is listed as an also_field rather than a separate program. Admits summer only, per the statistics page and the Graduate School table.
name: Statistics, Ph.D.
